examples.name: Sample — a corner wordmark and a background mark
paragraphs: The wordmark OSTREVANE with a yellow apple symbol sits in the bottom-right corner of the footer band, and a large faint version of the same apple sits behind the lower (CAPEX) table. The background apple is a faint repeat of the mark and adds nothing to the table; the wordmark becomes [logo: OSTREVANE] in the footer band. Expected boxes: the CAPEX table as one Table box; the footer band as page furniture, with the wordmark inside it.

examples.name: Sample — two stacked wordmarks on a slide
paragraphs: VELTRAND PROVIDENCE (set on two lines) and VELTRAND LIFE, each a red box with a white diamond symbol, top-right. Each wordmark is one marker; the two-line one joins its lines with a space. The slide's map is a real map with a two-entry legend — see Geographic Maps§12.2.4; it is elided here. Expected boxes: one box per wordmark.
